name: Premium Synthetic ATF - Red
description: Formulated to provide wear and rust protection, lubricity, good flow properties, excellent high and low temperature performance as well as stringent anti-shudder capability. This fluid is suitable for use in Ford, General Motors, Chrysler ATF+4, Allison C4, Volkswagen #G052 162A2, Audi, Volvo, Toyota (T-IV), Lexus, Honda Z1, Hyundai, Nissan (Matic-J), Infiniti, BMW, Mercedes Benz, and Jaguar.
application: MOC® Premium Synthetic ATF (#0611) must be used according to equipment manufacturer’s recommendations. Do not use in transmissions which require CVT or Dexron VI fluid.
